newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Avonmore says divisions performing well.
newsitem.headline: Avonmore says divisions performing well.

text.p: Avonmore Foods Plc on Monday said the company's dairy operations in the UK, the U.S. and continental Europe last year generated a 9.5 percent growth in turnover to 761.4 million Irish pounds.
Operating profits increased to 25.9 million Irish pounds from 24.8 million against a background of severe decline in world dairy product prices', the company said in a results statement.
Avonmore reported a rise of 13.7 percent in pre-tax profit to 36.45 million Irish pounds in 1996/7.

The group's worldwide milk pool increased by 5 percent to almost 500 million gallons during the year, with the U.S. accounting for approximately 40 percent. The remainder was almost equally divided between Ireland and the UK.

In Ireland the company's milk products division was impacted from early in the year by the fall in world dairy product prices but maintained buoyancy by 'switching operations to higher margin products'. The consumer products division consolidated its liquid milk market share and improved cheese sales, also recording strong growth in sales of convenience foods, particularly soups. In the UK Avonmore increased its share of the liquid milk market, primarily through the growth of sales to retail multiples and due to a decline in doorstep sales. In the U.S. turnover from the group's operations increased by 27 percent to 218 million Irish pounds. Avonmore West consolidated its position as the largest cheese and whey-based food ingredients manufacturer in north-west USA, with sales of cheese and food ingredients increasing, Avonmore said.

While margins in the Mid-West remained tight in 1996, sales in North America and the Pacific Rim were boosted, with substantial progress in the nutritional and processed foods markets, it said. In continental Europe, the Golden Foods division in Belgium increased sales to the pizza cheese market in Europe. In Hungary Avonmore said Paszto increased sales of liquid milk in the greater Budapest market. Turnover in Avonmore's meat division increased to 440.7 million from 412.3 million, although operating profits reduced by 0.9 million to 9.9 million.
